premise.claim: The v1alpha1 deprecation admission webhooks are redundant: the CRD deprecationWarning covers every v1alpha1 request without any webhook, and the v1alpha2 validating webhooks (default matchPolicy=Equivalent) route v1alpha1 writes through the conversion webhook into the v1alpha2 deprecated-workload-type gate. On the base, users saw two overlapping Warning: 299 headers per v1alpha1 write.
premise.reportedComponent: api/workloads/v1alpha1 deprecation admission webhooks + CRD deprecationWarning + v1alpha2 validating webhooks
premise.patchedComponent: same (webhooks removed; CRD warning text gains the 0.10.0 timeline)
premise.evidence: On base 73e05db4 (harness + base-only registration of the removed webhooks), a v1alpha1 RBG create returned exactly the two overlapping warnings the PR describes (results/p0-premise-base.txt, spec 3 failure lists both). On head 6108f204 the same write returns exactly one warning carrying the 0.10.0 timeline, and all enforcement specs pass (results/l2-envtest-head.txt, 7/7).
